function.name: workspace_bash
function.description: Run a bash command with the per-paper workspace as the working directory. Use it to clone the released code, build the venv, install dependencies, and run the experiment. Every command is recorded to evidence/commands.log. Returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and wallclock duration.

command.description: Bash command to run inside the workspace.

timeout.description: Seconds before the command is killed.
